candidate_ref.reason: fresh candidate identity is not created in preparation

scenario_manifest_ref.reason: mission scenarios and required set are not frozen

binding_policy.calibration_validation_isolation: required; calibration records cannot also serve as validation evidence

verification.purpose: implementation, discretization, convergence, residual, interface conservation and replay correctness

validation.purpose: candidate-bound comparison with independent measured or reference data

discrepancy.purpose: model-to-data or independent-code difference with direction, units and alignment

uncertainty.purpose: parameter, manufacturing, initial-condition, numerical, measurement and model-form uncertainty

source.reason: no data is downloaded or admitted in preparation

receipt.reason: no VVUQ execution is authorized in this preparation

limitations.reason: scope and extrapolation limits require candidate-bound review

minimum_gates: Verification pass cannot be relabeled validation pass.
A data item without license/permission, version and content hash remains unavailable.
A validation item must be independent of calibration and bound to the same candidate, geometry, operating point and scenario.
Discrepancy and uncertainty must propagate to every hard-gate margin; an interval crossing a gate remains unknown or failed per the frozen rule.
Historical reference artifacts remain read-only context and cannot create current VVUQ credit.
